_comment: Declares the composability tier. 'nested-mfe-spa' (display alias 'app-shell') = Capability-5: this plugin is the OUTER app shell of the dx-maps app, the Research Gallery. Its single element <doxa-maps-spa> renders a vertical-tab rail whose tabs each mount a REAL, independently embeddable plugin: the shell loads that bundle's script (URL from manifest.json) and creates its registered custom element in the pane. There is no iframe mode. Tab order and grouping live in NAV_MODEL/TAB_DEFS in doxa-maps-spa.vue; `composes` below lists the nine curated tabs as bundle/profile and must be kept in step with TAB_DEFS (check:composite reads it; the studio's "Inside doxa-maps-spa" tree shows it). Bundles not placed in a section appear under Experimental automatically. The tier is now DERIVED from the `composes` edges below at tree generation (a profile that composes anything is cap-4; one that composes a cap-4 is cap-5), and this explicit `type` is CHECKED against that derivation rather than being the only source: if the two disagree the build fails, because one of them is stale. discover.mjs still never infers tiers 3-5 on its own.
label: Deep Research (vertical-tab app shell: the nine production maps)
